identity.title: Safety Data Sheet: Sodium Hydroxide Solution, 50%

scan.summary: This is a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for Sodium Hydroxide Solution, 50% prepared by Northwest Alkali Products, Inc., a supplier. It documents hazard classification, first-aid measures, handling, storage, exposure controls, and regulatory information for this corrosive chemical under the OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, 29 CFR 1910.1200. Cascade Specialty Chemicals must ensure employees who handle this product have access to this SDS and understand its contents.
scan.freshness_note: Document revised March 18, 2024, approximately 18 months old as of September 2026. Freshness is adequate for an SDS; however, you should monitor for updates from the supplier.
